title: A high-arity counterexample to Pixton completeness in Chow
main_claim: For g=10^60 and n=3·C(g,3), an explicit alternated product Y of corrected rational-tail cubics F_J = D̄_ab D̄_ac − ½β_J lies in ker(q_{g,n}) (Chow and cohomology) but not in Pixton's original relation span P_{g,n}. So Pixton's completeness conjecture fails for this stable pair.
coverage:
Read in full: Sec 1–4, Sec 6 (exterior-ideal and arbitrary-color lemmas) and Sec 8. Read in part: Sec 5 (surface bound statement, low-divisor support, equivariant-exponent vanishing, short-length exclusion, block-cost table, localization proposition) and Sec 7 (weighted-pullback lemma, controlled-lifts statement and the start of its proof). I did not redo the Quot obstruction-theory construction, the EGL marked-universality proof or the residue computation of a_{N,t0}; the sibling entry reports checking those. Checked by hand:
- Detector: the all-ones Lagrangian count m=2s+3u, r=s+2u, s+3u=3r−m≥g+1+|σ|. Symmetric tests with more than g W_+ inputs vanish. The sgn alternation over the word stabilizer makes the value on Y equal |G|·Θ≠0.
- Detector: β terms lie outside the rational-tails locus.
- Relative Pfaffian identity via Fourier transform and [m]-eigenvalues; the coefficient is (b+1)!·N^{2b+2}·Σ over matchings.
- In the proof of Lemma 6.x, the cubic contraction T_γ becomes a bivector whose coefficient matrix is the third compound of γ, so it is nondegenerate. Lefschetz surjectivity in the exterior-ideal lemma.
- Sec 5: exponent 2t0−v<0. Isotropy kills the bare diagonals in 1- and 2-output blocks. Only bare triples reach 4/3 codimension per output.
- Repeated-color lemma: the Schur–Weyl ideal argument, and the vanishing of the double contraction (a²=0, ℓ(a)²=0, ∫e²=0, eW=0).
- All Sec 8 numerics: m0, D0>10^9 g², the small-loss bound below 10^17 g, d_e>D0/10, threshold below 0.99·D0, at most 3K+5 expensive blocks, and the large-deficit surplus (0.45(K−4)−140)g²>0.
- The heavy base has dimension ≤3g−2 < (b−1)²−1.

issues.description: The expansion of pulled raw cubics into pure lifts, pair×singleton noise and residuals with a base-divisor factor, uniformly across all descendant cut charts, is proved only at sketch level. The control of singleton classes (span of unit, canonical class and flag points) under every further cut and forgetting is asserted rather than worked out chart by chart.
issues.evidence: The proof reduces to the blowup decomposition and the triple-exceptional cancellation on the smooth heavy base, then claims the same shape persists under pullback to descendant charts with only brief justification.

issues.description: The relative EGL recursion is claimed to keep an arbitrary finite set of marked surface outputs, giving a universal sum of decorated equality diagonals. This is new beyond Kong's 1- and 2-output cases and is stated with a compressed proof. The block-cost argument and the scalar interface depend on it.
issues.evidence: The paper itself cites Kong2026 only for one and two marked outputs and asserts the general version.

issues.description: The lemma is stated for a multiplier whose base image lies in an irreducible Z. Cycles produced by localization can have several components of different dimensions, so the induction should be run per irreducible component of the base image. The dimension count still works per component.
issues.evidence: 'Let a cycle multiplier ... have base image contained in an irreducible closed subspace Z'; later steps produce sums of cycles over A without restating the decomposition.

sibling_notes: The family-053 board already had an entry for this exact dir (rank390, no_gap_found: Quot virtual rank 2t0+χ−3, residue and bridge −1/2 cancellation checked). This second pass agrees and has overwritten that entry with a combined summary.
